sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the single ship-level applicability gate requiring exactly one iceClass equal to nltl:iceClassIaSuper and exactly one bulbousBowPresent value false, plus the ship-owned positive B/L/T operands and declared quantity units. Add actual COMPLEX_READINESS validation for both brashIceResistanceCoefficientC1 and brashIceResistanceCoefficientC2: retain their force quantity domains and require readiness-level numerical-tolerance evidence tied to the expected formula results, with tolerance scaled from each expected result rather than the reported value.
